Starting Balances — Inventory Items

The Starting Balances - Inventory Items screen allows you to set up starting balances for the inventory items you've created under the Inventory Items tab in Manager. This feature is essential when initiating your inventory records in Manager with existing stock quantities and values.

To create a new starting balance for an inventory item, follow these steps:

  1. Click on the New Starting Balance button.

    InventoryItemsNewStartingBalance

  2. You will be taken to the Starting Balance screen for the inventory item.

For detailed instructions on how to complete the starting balance form, see Starting Balance for Inventory Item Form.
